sources.leo: DfE LEO graduate industry dashboard (Graduate labour market outcomes LEO 2023-24), OGL. CAH2 subject x SIC industry, by years after graduation. Bars = SIC division (2-digit), rolled up from the source's 3-digit groups via ONS SIC 2007.
sources.leo_note: Industry = employer sector (SIC), not occupation. Subject granularity is CAH2. A division's 'typical' pay is the graduate-weighted average of its 3-digit median earnings (the source publishes true medians only at 3-digit and section level); the drill-down shows those true 3-digit medians. Counts rounded to nearest 5; low counts suppressed; unmatched-industry dropped.
sources.fig12: HESA SB275 Figure 12, Graduate Outcomes 2023/24, undergraduates, work is an activity, all providers. Whole-percent shares.
sources.job_mapping: Reviewed HECoS → O*NET and ST → O*NET; CAH for grouping only.
sources.risk: AI axes: equal mean of scored exact linked occupations, then geometric mean. Pay/growth: openings-weighted UK parent groups. Openings: distinct UK parent groups, not exact-title vacancies or course places.
